mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_reviews WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_reviews SET base_commit=#{baseCommit},head_commit=#{headCommit},worktree_digest=#{worktreeDigest}, status='COMPLETED',result_payload=CAST(#{resultPayload} AS jsonb), error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status='RUNNING' AND snapshot_id=(SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId})

UPDATE task_reviews SET base_commit=#{baseCommit},head_commit=#{headCommit}, worktree_digest=#{worktreeDigest},status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status='RUNNING'
